definitions.gloss: to hone, to sharpen, to refine
definitions.explanation: To sharpen something to a fine, keen edge. Most commonly used figuratively for sharpening senses, sensibilities, skills, or awareness to an extremely high degree.

examples.japanese: ⟦{神経|しんけい}→神経：03257_shinkei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{研|と}ぎ{澄|す}ます。
{研|と}ぎ{澄|す}まされた⟦{感覚|かんかく}→感覚：02593_kankaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}き{分|わ}ける→聞き分ける：29600_kikiwakeru⟧。
examples.english: To distinguish sounds with sharpened senses.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{研|と}ぎ{澄|す}まされた⟦{職人|しょくにん}→職人：09868_shokunin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{技|わざ}→技：02172_waza⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{者|もの}→者：12734_mono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{圧倒|あっとう}する→圧倒する：17122_attousuru⟧。
examples.english: The craftsman's skill, honed through years of experience, overwhelms those who watch.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost always used figuratively in modern Japanese. The passive form {研|と}ぎ{澄|す}まされた (honed, refined) is very common as a modifier: {研|と}ぎ{澄|す}まされた⟦{感性|かんせい}→感性：12628_kansei⟧ (refined sensibility), {研|と}ぎ{澄|す}まされた⟦{神経|しんけい}→神経：03257_shinkei⟧ (sharpened nerves). Conveys a sense of extreme refinement through effort or experience.

WRITING:
⟦{研|と}ぐ→研ぐ：04377_togu⟧ means "to polish" or "to sharpen" and ⟦{澄|す}ます→澄ます：16578_sumasu⟧ means "to make clear/pure." Together they convey the idea of sharpening something to crystalline clarity.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{神経|しんけい}→神経：03257_shinkei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{研|と}ぎ{澄|す}ます: to sharpen one's nerves
- ⟦{感覚|かんかく}→感覚：02593_kankaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{研|と}ぎ{澄|す}ます: to hone one's senses
- {研|と}ぎ{澄|す}まされた⟦{感性|かんせい}→感性：12628_kansei⟧: refined sensibility
- {研|と}ぎ{澄|す}まされた{美|うつく}しさ: a keen, refined beauty
